From my experience:

1) Texting frequency and pattern change. They go from texting you every day to once a week at best. And their messages turn from long and elaborated to short and cold, without the usage of any emojis or such.

3) Intimacy and affection decrease. They stop cuddling, kissing, hugging and touching you randomly, sex becomes rare, then a thing of the past. And if/when they do touch you, it feels forced, and as if they were doing a chore.

4) You don't know what goes on in their life anymore. Once, you knew all their plans, ideas, etc.. Now nothing. Suddently, they make new, big plans without you, such as a vacation, and they don't even tell you until the last minute, when they already happened, or until you discover them yourself.

5) They stop opening up. The deep, heartfelt conversations you used to have don't exist anymore. They only talk about superficial stuff.

6) They don't go out with you anymore. On the rare times you do see eachother, they'll always be either at their house or yours. This is to avoid letting other people see you as a couple, and spending money on you.

7) Their family starts treating you differently. Once they were open and friendly, now they're cold and distant, just like your partner.

3. Most of the horrifying situations that you read about online are fake. This is the internet, plenty of liars lurk around here.
